Operator — Master (Tier III).

Trade — Case the place: Deliver a floor plan — entrances, watch rotations, one exploitable habit. Standard fee 90 marks (Intrigue).

Trick — Skeleton Key (1/scene): Bypass one lock, checkpoint, or seal, offscreen-grade, no roll.

Master step: the Operator's Knack (Underfoot) improves at this tier — see the class entry.
